analyst_notes: One of eight sister §15 companies (SMV Capital ONE–EIGHT, Pobřežní 249/46, Praha 8) presented on smvcapital.cz. The FIVE profile states a 'Capital Fund FIVE' strategy: equity stakes and convertible loans in CZ/CEE companies (B2B/B2C e-commerce, green tech, financial services), 10-year horizon, no leverage. ARES datumVzniku 2026-06-05. Investments are described as planned ('Plánované investice'); KID available only on request. Re-screen once deals are public.
